analogy.rationale: TLR7 is expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines, so a TLR7 agonist should elicit little transcriptional response; immunostimulants share the innate-immune activation program, while NFkB/IKK/JAK inhibitors and anti-inflammatory agents act on the same downstream inflammatory signaling axis and would be expected to show weak or opposing responses.
